title: Random hostile encounter
setting: A roadside ambush against a randomly chosen foe, ready instantly with no story generation.
conflict: You start in combat with the opening attack. Use it to test attacks, spells, dodging, potions, retreat and initiative.
arrival: Steel out — it's already on you

title: Let fate decide
setting: An unfamiliar corner of the world, created for your hero.
conflict: The Dungeon Master chooses a local mystery, the people caught in it, and the incident that draws you in.
arrival: A stranger at the right moment

title: The Last Caravan
setting: A wind-scoured oasis on the edge of a desert trade road.
conflict: The settlement's water has stopped flowing. A stranded caravan and the residents blame each other while an unknown creature prowls the old waterworks.
arrival: You arrive with the stranded caravan

title: A Bell Beneath the Ice
setting: A snowbound fishing harbor beside a frozen inlet.
conflict: A distress bell rings from an abandoned shore station. Two locals disagree about a missing expedition, and a creature blocks the route to the truth.
arrival: You seek shelter as the bell begins

title: A Stranger Wearing Your Name
setting: A lantern-lit canal quarter with a small market and shuttered archive.
conflict: A forged notice accuses your newly arrived hero of a theft. Two witnesses hold conflicting accounts, and a stolen ledger could expose the real culprit.
arrival: Your name is called at a market stall

title: The Garden That Remembers
setting: An overgrown sanctuary around a ruined glasshouse.
conflict: The sanctuary's caretaker has vanished after its plants began repeating old conversations. Two remaining residents need help, but a thorn-covered creature guards the missing person's trail.
arrival: You answer a plea at the sanctuary gate

title: The Broken Pact
setting: A mushroom village beneath a mountain, lit by blue spores.
conflict: A shared spring has turned bitter after a ceremonial offering disappeared. Two villagers offer different explanations, and a small cave creature guards a clue at the spring.
arrival: You stop in the village for supplies
